packages.label: שִׂמְחָה וְעוֹלָם הַחֵרוּת
packages.label_en: Joy and the World of Freedom
packages.reason: שמחה (Joy) and עולם החרות (the world of freedom) share the same essential nature: they are two expressions of the same inner reality of liberation. The Rebbe states explicitly 'שִׂמְחָה הוּא עוֹלָם הַחֵרוּת' — joy IS the world of freedom. They are not two different things where one produces the other; joy itself is the domain of freedom, and freedom itself is what joy expresses. Both describe the state of the mind and spirit when unchained from depression, exile, and constraint. This is the positive pole of the Torah: the holy domain of simcha as the path back to God.
